team.plugin.name: Agent team
team.menu.tip: Subagents spawned by this session: state, elapsed time; click a row for its run log
team.menu.openPanel: Open the team panel (message, remove, other sessions' teammates)
team.menu.hint: Click a row for its read-only run log. Stop is best effort, messages are relayed by the host, and finished teammates can be removed.
team.panel.title: Agent team
team.panel.desc: This is the team spawned by the current session; switch sessions and it is a different team. Teammates from other sessions are listed at the bottom and can be inspected or removed.
team.panel.peekDesc: The run log is read-only; Back to roster returns to the team list.
team.panel.empty: This session has no teammates yet. With the Subagents plugin enabled, work the model hands off through the subagent tool shows up here.
team.panel.othersHint: These teammates were spawned by other sessions (or older versions): click a row for its run log, and finished ones can be removed. Switch back to the session that spawned a running teammate to manage it.
team.row.stopTip: Stop this teammate (ends the current round but keeps it resumable — send a message and it continues; use Remove to delete it)
team.row.messageTip: Send this teammate a message (relayed by the host)
team.row.removeTip: Remove from the roster and delete its run log (not moved to the trash)
team.row.removeDetail: This deletes its roster entry and run log file; stop a running teammate before removing it.
team.time.runningTip: How long it has been running (refreshed every second)
team.time.totalTip: Total time from dispatch to finish
team.peek.error: Could not read the run log: {message}
team.peek.empty: It has not started working yet.
team.tab.roundsTip: Model request rounds it has started
